title: hotfix: fix race in SLO enforcer regional failover causing double load-shedding
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: production incidents showed the SLO enforcer could enter a short-lived race during regional failover which caused duplicate load-shedding signals and rapid cross-region thrashing. This hotfix addresses the race by serializing failover state transitions, adding a compact distributed lease and stronger idempotency for load-shed signals, and adding extra observability to validate behavior under recovery. Changes: 1) introduce enforcer_failover_mutex and minimal lease key used during region switch to prevent concurrent decision paths; 2) make load_shed() idempotent by tagging actions with decision_id and short TTL so duplicate signals are ignored; 3) add metrics and trace spans around failover decision boundaries and lease refresh; 4) tighten default backoff/hysteresis to avoid oscillation for 30s after a failover. Testing and rollout: unit+integration tests added, chaos test included in perf-canary job, staged rollout to canary then 25% traffic before full rollout. This PR is a hotfix: small API surface and safe to squash merge. Related: ENG-4721 (incident postmortem), SUP-9123 (customer escalations).
